scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Chinese University Program) at Fudan University 2026

existing.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for CSC scholarship consideration. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.
existing.duration: Bachelor's: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-2 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years

scholarships.title: Zhejiang University "Belt and Road" International School of Medicine Scholarship (PhD)
scholarships.official_source: International School of Medicine, Zhejiang University (ZJU-ISM)

existing.funding_period: per month (tier A); RMB 3,500 per month under tier B
existing.description: The scholarship is set up and funded by the International School of Medicine of Zhejiang University and is open only to doctoral candidates in medical programmes at that school, whose teaching base is in Yiwu, in central Zhejiang Province. The official page sets out two full-scholarship tiers (A and B): both exempt tuition and provide free on-campus accommodation and comprehensive medical insurance for international students, with a monthly living allowance of RMB 7,000 under tier A and RMB 3,500 under tier B. Applicants apply by emailing the school's scholarship application form and uploading the same form into the Zhejiang University international student application system. The page is a standing terms document; the application deadline it currently publishes is 28 February for the cycle whose results are read out in late July or early August.
eligibility: Must meet the Zhejiang University doctoral admission requirements and the International School of Medicine doctoral admission requirements

In the ZJU international student application system, the preferred college ("志愿学院") must be the Medical School (医学院) and the preferred programme ("志愿专业") must be a programme carrying the suffix "国际医学院(International School of Medicine)"
Must not hold any other scholarship at the same time ("未同时获得其他各类奖学金")
Open to both domestic and international doctoral candidates; Chinese applicants including those from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan must refer to a separate notice
Scholarship recipients who arrive in China must not change their admitting institution, their programme of study or the length of their study
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to doctoral candidates for medical programmes who apply to the International School of Medicine at Zhejiang University and choose it in the ZJU international student application system, and who are not receiving any other scholarship at the same time. The scholarship is open to both domestic and international doctoral candidates, with Chinese applicants (including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) directed to a separate notice.
benefits: Full tuition waiver (免交学费) under both tier A and tier B
Free on-campus accommodation (提供免费校内住宿) under both tiers
Monthly living allowance of RMB 7,000 under tier A (全额奖学金 A类) and RMB 3,500 under tier B (全额奖学金 B类)
Comprehensive medical insurance for international students studying in China (来华留学生综合医疗保险)
Annual scholarship review, with the scholarship suspended or cancelled if the holder fails the review
coverage: Living allowance of RMB 7,000 per month (tier A) or RMB 3,500 per month (tier B)
Comprehensive medical insurance for international students coming to China
requirements: Meet Zhejiang University and International School of Medicine doctoral admission requirements
Select the Medical School and an International School of Medicine programme in the ZJU international student application system

Submit the school's own scholarship application form in Chinese or English by email to ismgraduate@zju.edu.cn with the subject line set as application number + passport name + programme name, and upload the same form to the ZJU international student application system
Do not hold any other scholarship at the same time
Pass the school's selection, which considers research ability, academic performance, language level and video interview
Agree that the scholarship period matches the programme length and that the institution, programme and study period may not be changed
documents: 《浙江大学"一带一路"国际医学院奖学金申请表》 - the school's scholarship application form, completed in Chinese or English, emailed to ismgraduate@zju.edu.cn and uploaded to the ZJU international student application system

《外国人体格检查记录》 - the physical examination record form for foreigners, submitted as a copy, completed in Chinese or English by the required health examination items, valid for six months; incomplete items, a missing photo, a missing cross-page seal, a missing doctor's signature or hospital seal render it invalid
无犯罪记录证明 - a police clearance certificate issued by the local public security authority, valid for six months
All documents required for admission under the Zhejiang University international student (doctoral) admission guide
GRE or NTS-GAT scores, which the school encourages applicants to provide but does not require
application_method: Complete the International School of Medicine scholarship application form in Chinese or English
Email the form to ismgraduate@zju.edu.cn with the subject line set as application number + passport name + programme name
Upload the same form, together with the full admission dossier, to the Zhejiang University international student application system at http://isinfosys.zju.edu.cn/recruit/login.shtml

Email and online application must both be completed before the deadline; the school states it will not accept mailed paper documents, and that emailed documents other than the scholarship application form will not be reviewed
Check the Zhejiang University international student application system for the result at the end of July or the beginning of August
existing.selection_notes: The university states that applicants are selected on the basis of research ability, academic performance, language level and video interview performance (学校将根据申请人的研究能力、学业成绩、语言水平和视频面试情况等因素综合考虑择优录取). No minimum English test score is published on the scholarship page; it refers applicants to the Zhejiang University international student (doctoral) admission guide for admission-level language requirements. Recipients are subject to an annual scholarship review, and scholarship status can be suspended or cancelled if the review is failed. If a holder suspends studies for serious illness they must return home at their own travel cost; with university approval the scholarship entitlement can be retained for up to one year but the living allowance stops during the suspension, and suspension for other reasons forfeits the entitlement. The living allowance is paid monthly from the date of enrolment: a full month if registered on or before the 15th, half a month if after the 15th; it continues over official holidays and can be paid retrospectively on return, but is suspended for that month if a holder is absent from registration or leaves without leave or is absent from class for more than two weeks for non-health reasons.
existing.best_fit: Doctoral applicants in medicine, nursing, pharmacology and related health sciences who want to study at Zhejiang University's International School of Medicine in Yiwu and can satisfy the school's separate admission requirements, including a medical examination form and police clearance certificate.
existing.notes: This is a school-level award created and funded by the International School of Medicine itself (本奖学金项目由浙江大学"一带一路"国际医学院设立), distinct from the Chinese Government Scholarship programmes that the same university administers. The page states that final interpretation rests with the International School of Medicine and the ZJU International Education College.
existing.duration: The scholarship period matches the length of the doctoral programme, stated as 3-4 years for doctoral study with the exact period as specified in the admission notice
existing.application_period: Annual cycle tied to the Zhejiang University international doctoral intake. The page read on 2026-10-04 still documents the cycle with a 28 February application deadline and late July/early August results; no 2027 intake call had been posted on the International College notice board at the time of checking (the most recent notice there is dated 2026-07-28).
existing.deadline_display: The official page publishes an application deadline of 28 February (申请截止时间：2025年2月28日) for the cycle it documents, with results readable in the ZJU international student application system at the end of July or the beginning of August
